question: Does the combined decoder (validation-selected transformer/MLP blend, optionally plus bounded attention+BCE correction) beat BOTH standalone models on recordings never used in development?
data_state: frozen BEFORE download; no holdout activity, running or metadata values inspected; only public archive directories and first-array npy headers (TX60_s2, D9) read to confirm format

A_visual_later_sessions.note: same mice as development (TX60/TX61/VR2), different days and newly drawn neurons; tests across-day generalization, NOT new animals

B_sensorimotor_new_mice.rule: earliest recording per mouse; D8_2021_11_29_1 excluded and never scored
B_sensorimotor_new_mice.note: 5 never-used mice, sensorimotor rather than visual cortex

preparation: identical to experiments/2026-10-06_facemap_validation/dataset.py prepare(): keys spks/run, common prefix (length difference<=1), panel_seed7101 512 eligible neurons, 60/20/20 chronological splits with 64-frame gaps, 4096 training cap, training-only scaling, target abs(run) standardized on training
parents: train fresh per recording: optimized_attention and optimized_population_mlp configs from facemap_validation protocol, seeds401/402/403, same optimization and earliest-minimum validation checkpoint selection; original development checkpoints cannot be reused because neurons differ
blend: alpha in {0,.25,.5,.75,1} (transformer fraction) selected per recording by mean-over-seed validation MSE of float64 zero-clipped predictions; ties to smaller alpha
correction: bounded-hybrid attention_bce exactly as experiments/2026-10-07_bounded_hybrid/run.py (width16 depth1 patch4, delta=.5*tanh*(1-sigmoid), BCE weight1, active penalty.1, 24 epochs, seeds601/602/603 paired with401/402/403, epoch selected on validation incl. epoch0); full strength, no post hoc scaling; mlp_bce and mse-only arms not run

gates.per_set_vs_each_parent: mean relative MSE gain>=5%; recording wins>=ceil(6/7*n) (A 3/3, B 5/5); seed wins>=ceil(2/3*3n) (A 6/9, B 10/15); worst recording harm<=10%; mean MAE gain>=0
gates.secondary_also_vs_blend: mean gain>=5%; quiet wins>=ceil(5/7*n) (A 3/3, B 4/5); no recording active MSE >5% worse than blend
gates.thresholds: copied unchanged from the development studies; not tuned to holdout
gates.report_regardless: zero-speed and training-mean controls, per-recording R2/MSE/MAE, quiet/active slices; sets A and B reported separately, never pooled into one pass

barrier: prepare -> fit all parents -> lock alphas -> fit corrections -> lock every checkpoint hash -> single test scoring -> independent audit. No refits, reselection or threshold changes after scoring. Integrity/format failures stop and are documented, never silently worked around.
limits: one lab and dataset; set A reuses mice; set B changes brain area; exploratory, no significance claim from 3 or 5 recordings
